title: Singular-ideal comparison from a compatible lifting diagram and smoothness transfer
statement: Let R, S, C, D and Λ be commutative rings, with D an R-algebra and C an S-algebra. Write H_D = H_{D/R} and H_C = H_{C/S} for the singular ideals [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Let I ⊆ D and K,L ⊆ Λ be ideals, and let δ : D → Λ, ψ : D/I → Λ/L, red : Λ/K → Λ/L, c : C → D/I and τ : C → Λ/K be ring maps. Suppose ψ∘q_I=q_L∘δ, red∘q_K=q_L and ψ∘c=red∘τ, where the q are quotient maps. Assume L ⊆ √(δ(H_D)Λ). Assume also that for every prime q of D/I, smoothness of S → C at c⁻¹(q) implies smoothness of R → D at q_I⁻¹(q). Then the ideal of Λ/K generated by τ(H_C) is contained in q_K(√(δ(H_D)Λ)).

source.place: Lemma 07F0, final verification using 07CP(c); generic prime/radical argument written out by G2

proof.text: For x ∈ H_C choose y ∈ Λ with q_K(y)=τ(x). For every prime p containing J=δ(H_D)Λ, L ⊆ √J ⊆ p makes p descend to a prime pbar of Λ/L. Pull back pbar along ψ to q in Spec(D/I). The equation ψ q_I=q_L δ gives H_D ⊆ q_I⁻¹(q), so this inverse image prime is nonsmooth by singularIdeal_zeroLocus. Smoothness transfer implies c⁻¹(q) is nonsmooth, hence contains H_C. Therefore ψ(c(x)) lies in pbar. The equations ψ c=red τ and red q_K=q_L show q_L(y) ∈ pbar, so y ∈ p. Ideal.radical_eq_sInf yields y ∈ √J. Use quotient-map surjectivity and Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective, then the ideal-map adjunction, to obtain the inclusion.

proof_origin.place: 07F0 final verification, using the smoothness clause of 07CP(c); generalized and fully proved by second reader G2 on 2026-10-13; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07F0 checked

mathlib_searches.query: singular locus inclusion using a commuting diagram of ring maps and smoothness at primes
mathlib_searches.results: LeanSearch returned candidates about smooth loci and localization, but no theorem expressing this two-quotient diagram with smoothness transfer. No exact match.
4 hits: map_radical_le, map_radical_of_surjective and two localization lemmas. None incorporates the diagram or smoothness transfer. Used the more direct prime intersection argument.

msearch Mathlib grep returned zero hits (these are project names). Independent rg on lean/Sheaf and lean/WeilConjectures found singularIdeal_zeroLocus and equivalence/base-change comparisons, but no theorem for this lifting diagram. Searched also annihilator/power lemmas and existing Popescu modules; used popescu_lifting rather than introducing a core existence hole.
